title: vtc-00: hosted livestream playback endpoints
description: Decide (Mark): extend VTCLivestream with a mode (outbound push vs hosted) or add a separate type. Hosted mode carries server-set playbackEndpoints: [{protocol, url, latencyHint, ...}] where protocol is an open string set (e.g. hls, dash, whep, moq; servers MAY add others; clients ignore unknown ones) and latencyHint is coarse and protocol-neutral (e.g. interactive / low / standard, no second counts tied to one protocol). Optional track lists (audio languages, captions) described generically. No vendor names.
